meta.note: src=official 为游戏内效果原文（占位符已按 wiki/道具数值填充）；manual=人工整理；wiki=官方句缺失时回退的 wiki 英文原文（zh 为空、未经翻译，官方中文永远优先）

Amulet_AbrasiveWhetstone.en: When attacking a BLEEDING enemy, Critical Chance is increased by 15% and Critical Damage is increased by 15%.

Amulet_AnkhOfPower.zh: 所有伤害提高 15%。消耗圣物可使加成提高 25%，持续 15 秒。
Amulet_AnkhOfPower.zhTpl: 所有伤害提高 {DamageMod}%。消耗圣物可使加成提高 {TotalBonus}%，持续 {BoostDuration} 秒。
Amulet_AnkhOfPower.en: Grants a {DamageMod}% increase to All Damage. Consuming a Relic increases the bonus to {TotalBonus}% for {BoostDuration}s.

Amulet_BeadsOfTheValorous.zh: 每失去最大生命值的 5%，减伤和移动速度提高 1%。血量为 50% 最大生命值或以下时，加成翻倍。最多叠加 10 层。
Amulet_BeadsOfTheValorous.zhTpl: 每失去最大生命值的 {HealthThreshold}%，减伤和移动速度提高 {DamageReduction/MovementBuff}%。血量为 {BonusThreshold}% 最大生命值或以下时，加成翻倍。最多叠加 {MaxStacks} 层。
Amulet_BeadsOfTheValorous.en: Increases Damage Reduction and Movement Speed by {DamageReduction/MovementBuff}% for every {HealthThreshold}% of missing Max Health. Bonus is doubled at or below {BonusThreshold}% Max Health. Max {MaxStacks} stacks.

Amulet_BirthrightOfTheLost.en: Increases All Damage by 10%. On Perfect Dodge, apply EXPOSED on the attacker and enemies with 4m of the wearer for 15s.

Amulet_BrazenAlloy.zh: 暴击率提高 1.5%，瞄准时移动速度每秒提高 2.5%。最多叠加 10层。闪避、滑铲或扑倒会移除叠加效果。
Amulet_BrazenAlloy.zhTpl: 暴击率提高 {CritChanceMod}%，瞄准时移动速度每秒提高 {AimSpeedMoveMod}%。最多叠加 {MaxStacks}层。闪避、滑铲或扑倒会移除叠加效果。
Amulet_BrazenAlloy.en: Increases Critical Chance by {CritChanceMod}% and Movement Speed while Aiming by {AimSpeedMoveMod}% per second. Max {MaxStacks} stacks. Dodge, Slide, or Flop removes stacks.

Amulet_BrewmastersCork.zh: 激活合剂的上限增加 2，并且每有一种合剂激活，所有受到的伤害就降低 2%。
Amulet_BrewmastersCork.zhTpl: 激活合剂的上限增加 {ConcoctionLimit}，并且每有一种合剂激活，所有受到的伤害就降低 {DamageReduction}%。
Amulet_BrewmastersCork.en: Increases active Concoction Limit by {ConcoctionLimit} and reduces all incoming damage by {DamageReduction}% for each active concoction.

Amulet_BrokenPocketWatch.zh: 体力回复增加 25，体力消耗减少 50%。
Amulet_BrokenPocketWatch.zhTpl: 体力回复增加 {StaminaRegen}，体力消耗减少 {StaminaDeltaMod}%。
Amulet_BrokenPocketWatch.en: Increases Stamina Regeneration by {StaminaRegen} and reduces Stamina Cost by {StaminaDeltaMod}%.

Amulet_ButchersFetish.zh: 在使用蓄力近战攻击击中敌人后，暴击率增加 15%，暴击伤害提高 25%，持续 5 秒。
Amulet_ButchersFetish.zhTpl: 在使用蓄力近战攻击击中敌人后，暴击率增加 {CritChance}%，暴击伤害提高 {CritDamageMod}%，持续 {Duration} 秒。
Amulet_ButchersFetish.en: Increases Critical Chance by {CritChance}% and Critical Damage by {CritDamageMod}% for {Duration}s after striking an enemy with a Charged Melee Attack.

Amulet_CanineKeepsake.zh: 每有 2.5% 的总生命值转换为灰色生命，所有伤害提高 1.5%，暴击率提高 1.5%，暴击伤害提高 5%。最多叠加 10 层。
Amulet_CanineKeepsake.zhTpl: 每有 {AllDamageMod}% 的总生命值转换为灰色生命，所有伤害提高 {CritChanceMod}%，暴击率提高 {CritDamageMod}%，暴击伤害提高 {GreyHealthThreshold}%。最多叠加 {MaxStacks} 层。
Amulet_CanineKeepsake.en: Increases All Damage by {AllDamageMod}%, Critical Chance by {CritChanceMod}%, and Critical Damage by {CritDamageMod}% for every {GreyHealthThreshold}% of total Health present as Grey Health. Max {MaxStacks} stacks.

Amulet_CervineKeepsake.zh: 圣物使用后，获得一层红鹿的召唤，持续 30 秒。最多叠加 5 层。 红鹿的召唤：每层移动速度提高 4%。红鹿的召唤结束时，每层回复 1 点圣物充能。
Amulet_CervineKeepsake.zhTpl:
圣物使用后，获得一层红鹿的召唤，持续 {Duration} 秒。最多叠加 {MaxStacks} 层。

红鹿的召唤：每层移动速度提高 {MoveSpeedBuff}%。红鹿的召唤结束时，每层回复 {RelicRefund} 点圣物充能。
Amulet_CervineKeepsake.en:
On Relic Use, gain a stack of CALL OF THE DOE for {Duration}s. Max {MaxStacks} stacks.

CALL OF THE DOE: Increases Movement Speed by {MoveSpeedBuff}% per stack. When CALL OF THE DOE expires, regain {RelicRefund} Relic Charge per stack.

Amulet_CessationBulbel.en: Activating a Mod consumes all current SHIELD consumed, increases All Damage dealt by 4% for 10s. Max 10 stacks.

Amulet_ChainsOfAmplification.zh: 对承受状态效果的目标造成的伤害提高 20%。
Amulet_ChainsOfAmplification.zhTpl: 对承受状态效果的目标造成的伤害提高 {TempStatusDamageMod}%。
Amulet_ChainsOfAmplification.en: Increases all damage dealt to targets suffering from a Status Effect by {TempStatusDamageMod}%.

Amulet_ChefMedal.zh: 完美闪避会自动触发需要使用圣物激活的效果。
Amulet_ChefMedal.zhTpl: 完美闪避会自动触发需要使用圣物激活的效果。
Amulet_ChefMedal.en: On Perfect Dodge, automatically trigger effects that require Relic Use to activate.

Amulet_CleansingStone.zh: 对佩戴者施加的元素状态效果持续时间减少 50%。使用圣物将清除自身元素状态效果，并使 20 米范围内的所有盟友回复相当于佩戴者最大生命值 25% 的生命。
Amulet_CleansingStone.zhTpl: 对佩戴者施加的元素状态效果持续时间减少 {PlayerStatusEffectDurationMod}%。使用圣物将清除自身元素状态效果，并使 {Range} 米范围内的所有盟友回复相当于佩戴者最大生命值 {HealScalar}% 的生命。
Amulet_CleansingStone.en: Reduces Duration of Elemental Status Effects against wearer by {PlayerStatusEffectDurationMod}%. Relic use cleanses Elemental Status effects and grants {HealScalar}% of wearers Max Health to all allies within {Range}m when cleansed.

Amulet_CoreBooster.zh: 在击杀一名敌人后，弱点伤害提高 50%，持续 10 秒。
Amulet_CoreBooster.zhTpl: 在击杀一名敌人后，弱点伤害提高 {WeakspotDamagePercent}%，持续 {Duration} 秒。
Amulet_CoreBooster.en: Increases Weakspot Damage by {WeakspotDamagePercent}% for {Duration}s after killing an enemy.

Amulet_CostOfBetrayal.zh: 圣物充能次数降低至 1 次。佩戴者拥有1 次圣物充能时，所有伤害提高 25%。佩戴者圣物充能次数耗尽时，受到的伤害提高 25%。如果无充能次数持续 15 秒，则可重新获得 1 次圣物充能。
Amulet_CostOfBetrayal.zhTpl: 圣物充能次数降低至 {RelicChargeCap} 次。佩戴者拥有{RelicChargeCap} 次圣物充能时，所有伤害提高 {DamageBuff}%。佩戴者圣物充能次数耗尽时，受到的伤害提高 {IncDamageDebuff}%。如果无充能次数持续 {RefreshRate} 秒，则可重新获得 {RelicRecharge} 次圣物充能。
Amulet_CostOfBetrayal.en: Reduces Relic Charges to {RelicChargeCap}. Increases All Damage by {DamageBuff}% when wearer has {RelicChargeCap} Relic Charge. Increases incoming damage by {IncDamageDebuff}% when wearer has no Relic Charge. After {RefreshRate}s of having no Relic Charges, regain {RelicRecharge} Relic Charge.

Amulet_CrisisCore.zh: 当受到的单一敌人伤害超过最大生命值的 15% 时，自动触发需要完美闪避才能激活的效果，并获得 15% 减伤，持续 3 秒。 每 3 秒只能触发一次。
Amulet_CrisisCore.zhTpl:
当受到的单一敌人伤害超过最大生命值的 {HealthTreshold}% 时，自动触发需要完美闪避才能激活的效果，并获得 {DamageReduction}% 减伤，持续 {CooldownDuration} 秒。

每 {CooldownDuration} 秒只能触发一次。
Amulet_CrisisCore.en:
When a single source of Enemy Damage exceeds {HealthTreshold}% of Max Health, automatically trigger effects that require Perfect Dodge to activate and gain {DamageReduction}% Damage Reduction for {CooldownDuration}s.

Can only happen once every {CooldownDuration} seconds.

Amulet_DaredevilsCharm.zh: 每个空护甲槽位可使所有伤害增加 7.5%，移动速度增加 3.75%。
Amulet_DaredevilsCharm.zhTpl: 每个空护甲槽位可使所有伤害增加 {DamageMod}%，移动速度增加 {MovementSpeed}%。
Amulet_DaredevilsCharm.en: Gain {DamageMod}% to All Damage dealt and {MovementSpeed}% Movement Speed for each empty Armor slot.

Amulet_DeathSoakedIdol.zh: 20 米范围内，每有一个受不同负面状态效果影响的单位，所有伤害提高 6%。最多叠加 5 层。
Amulet_DeathSoakedIdol.zhTpl: {Range} 米范围内，每有一个受不同负面状态效果影响的单位，所有伤害提高 {DamageBuff}%。最多叠加 {MaxStacks} 层。
Amulet_DeathSoakedIdol.en: Increases All Damage by {DamageBuff}% for each entity within {Range}m suffering from a unique Negative Status Effect. Max {MaxStacks} stacks.

Amulet_DeathsEmbrace.en: Gain 15% to All Damage when Health is not completely full. When below 50% Health, gain an additional 10% bonus to All Damage and HASTE +7% speed to the following actions: Using consumables Evading Melee attacks Mod casts Skill casts Charging weapons (bows, fusion rifles) Firing weapons Reloading weapons Swapping weapons Environmental traversal (vaulting, climbing, wading) Movement (walking, sprinting, crouching, aiming).

Amulet_DecayedMargin.zh: 获得相当于所造成基础伤害 3% 的生命偷取。每失去25% 的生命，额外获得 3% 的近战生命偷取。生命全满时，近战伤害提高 35%。
Amulet_DecayedMargin.zhTpl: 获得相当于所造成基础伤害 {MeleeHealthStealMod}% 的生命偷取。每失去{HealthThreshold}% 的生命，额外获得 {MeleeHealthStealMod}% 的近战生命偷取。生命全满时，近战伤害提高 {MeleeDamageMod}%。
Amulet_DecayedMargin.en: Gain {MeleeHealthStealMod}% of base Melee Damage dealt as Lifesteal. For each {HealthThreshold}% missing Health, gain {MeleeHealthStealMod}% additional Melee Lifesteal. When Health is full, gain {MeleeDamageMod}% Melee Damage.

Amulet_DetonationTrigger.en: Increases Explosion damage by 25%. Explosions apply 155 → 465 BURNING damage over 5s.

Amulet_DifferenceEngine.zh: 持盾时：全部伤害 +20%，并返还 4.5% 基础伤害为生命偷取

Amulet_DownwardSpiral.zh: 射速提高 10%，近战速度提高 15%。每损失 10% 的最大生命值，远程伤害提高 4%（最多 20%），近战伤害提高 5%（最多 25%）
Amulet_DownwardSpiral.zhTpl: 射速提高 {FireSpeedMod}%，近战速度提高 {MeleeAttackSpeedMod}%。每损失 {HealthThreshold}% 的最大生命值，远程伤害提高 {RangedDamageModPerLevel}%（最多 {RangedDamageModMax}%），近战伤害提高 {MeleeDamageModPerLevel}%（最多 {MeleeDamageModMax}%）
Amulet_DownwardSpiral.en: Increase Fire Rate by {FireSpeedMod}% and Melee Speed by {MeleeAttackSpeedMod}%. For every missing {HealthThreshold}% of Max Health, gain {RangedDamageModPerLevel}% Ranged damage (Max {RangedDamageModMax}%) and {MeleeDamageModPerLevel}% Melee damage (Max {MeleeDamageModMax}%)

Amulet_EchoChamber.zh: 爆炸伤害提高 10%，群体伤害范围增加 25%。爆炸伤害会同时施加暴露效果，持续 5 秒。最多 15 秒。 暴露：目标受到的所有来源的伤害提高 15%。
Amulet_EchoChamber.zhTpl:
爆炸伤害提高 {ExplosiveDamageMod}%，群体伤害范围增加 {AOESizeMod}%。爆炸伤害会同时施加暴露效果，持续 {ExposeDuration} 秒。最多 {MaxDuration} 秒。

暴露：目标受到的所有来源的伤害提高 15%。
Amulet_EchoChamber.en:
Increases Explosive Damage by {ExplosiveDamageMod}% and AOE Size by {AOESizeMod}%. Inflicting Explosive Damage applies EXPOSED for {ExposeDuration}s. Max {MaxDuration}s.

EXPOSED: Target receives 15% additional damage from all sources.

Amulet_EchoOfTheForest.zh: 使用圣物时，获得森之赠礼，持续 15 秒。森之赠礼结束后，圣物会重新施放效果。
Amulet_EchoOfTheForest.zhTpl: 使用圣物时，获得森之赠礼，持续 {Duration} 秒。森之赠礼结束后，圣物会重新施放效果。
Amulet_EchoOfTheForest.en: On Relic Use, gain GIFT OF THE FOREST for {Duration}s. When Gift of the Forest expires, Relic effect is recast.

Amulet_EffigyPendant.zh: 当存在灰色生命时，造成的所有伤害提高 15%，减伤提高 10%，并获得 1 额外攻击，持续至灰色生命被移除。
Amulet_EffigyPendant.zhTpl: 当存在灰色生命时，造成的所有伤害提高 {DamageMod}%，减伤提高 {DamageReductionMod}%，并获得 {AdditionalGreyHealthHits} 额外攻击，持续至灰色生命被移除。
Amulet_EffigyPendant.en: While Grey Health is present, gain {DamageMod}% to all damage dealt, {DamageReductionMod}% damage reduction, and {AdditionalGreyHealthHits} additional hit before Grey Health is removed.

Amulet_EffluviumEnhancer.zh: 强酸伤害提高 25%，腐蚀伤害提高 50%。
Amulet_EffluviumEnhancer.zhTpl: 强酸伤害提高 {AcidDamageMod}%，腐蚀伤害提高 {CorrodedDamageMod}%。
Amulet_EffluviumEnhancer.en: Increases ACID damage by {AcidDamageMod}% and CORROSIVE damage by {CorrodedDamageMod}%.

Amulet_EmergencySwitch.zh: 当生命低于 50% 时，使用圣物时消耗的几率降低 50%。使用时不会消耗最后一层圣物充能，但 30 秒内不可再次触发该效果。
Amulet_EmergencySwitch.zhTpl: 当生命低于 {HealthThreshold}% 时，使用圣物时消耗的几率降低 {DragonHeartSaveChance}%。使用时不会消耗最后一层圣物充能，但 {Cooldown} 秒内不可再次触发该效果。
Amulet_EmergencySwitch.en: When below {HealthThreshold}% health, chance to consume Relic on use is reduced by {DragonHeartSaveChance}%. Final Relic Charge is not consumed on use, but effect cannot be triggered again for {Cooldown}s.

Amulet_EnergizedNeckCoil.zh: 状态效果伤害提高 20%。施加伤害状态效果会在 2 米范围制造爆炸，造成其总伤害 20% 的伤害。 每个目标每隔 5 秒可受一次影响。
Amulet_EnergizedNeckCoil.zhTpl:
状态效果伤害提高 {StatusEffectDamageMod}%。施加伤害状态效果会在 {Range} 米范围制造爆炸，造成其总伤害 {StatusDamageScalar}% 的伤害。

每个目标每隔 {CooldownDuration} 秒可受一次影响。
Amulet_EnergizedNeckCoil.en:
Increases Status Effect damage by {StatusEffectDamageMod}%. Directly applying a damaging Status Effect creates a {Range}m Explosion for {StatusDamageScalar}% of its full damage.

Each target can be affected once every {CooldownDuration}s.

Amulet_EnergyDiverter.zh: 持盾时：暴击几率 +10%、全部伤害 +15%

Amulet_EscalationProtocol.zh: 击杀敌人时，所有伤害提高 2.5%，持续 10 秒。可叠加 10 层。造成伤害会刷新计时。
Amulet_EscalationProtocol.zhTpl: 击杀敌人时，所有伤害提高 {DamageMod}%，持续 {Duration} 秒。可叠加 {MaxStackCount} 层。造成伤害会刷新计时。
Amulet_EscalationProtocol.en: Increases all damage dealt by {DamageMod}% for {Duration}s after killing an enemy. Stacks {MaxStackCount}x. Dealing damage refreshes the timer.

Amulet_ExhaustValve.zh: 增加 25% 的热量衰减速度，且生成热量的武器不再过热。达到最大热量时，射速降低 20% %。
Amulet_ExhaustValve.zhTpl: 增加 {HeatDecayIncrease}% 的热量衰减速度，且生成热量的武器不再过热。达到最大热量时，射速降低 {FireRateReduction}% %。
Amulet_ExhaustValve.en: Increases Heat Decay Rate by {HeatDecayIncrease}% and Weapons that Generate Heat no longer Overheat. At Max Heat, Fire Rate is reduced by {FireRateReduction}%.

Amulet_FragrantThorn.zh: 状态效果伤害 +20%；对同一目标施加 ≥4 种独特负面状态时挂 破绽 15 秒（全来源承伤 +15%）

Amulet_FullMoonCirclet.zh: 远程伤害吸血 3% 基础伤害；满血时远程伤害 +25%

Amulet_GiftOfEuphoria.zh: 消耗 20 体力时，获得 5% 暴击率，持续 5 秒。最多可叠加 5 层。
Amulet_GiftOfEuphoria.zhTpl: 消耗 {StaminaThreshold} 体力时，获得 {CriticalChance}% 暴击率，持续 {BuffDuration} 秒。最多可叠加 {MaxStacks} 层。
Amulet_GiftOfEuphoria.en: Spending {StaminaThreshold} Stamina grants {CriticalChance}% Critical Chance for {BuffDuration}s. Max {MaxStacks} stacks.

Amulet_GiftOfMelancholy.zh: 体力到达 100% 时，所有伤害提高 25%，持续 7秒。
Amulet_GiftOfMelancholy.zhTpl: 体力到达 {StaminaThreshold}% 时，所有伤害提高 {DamageBuff}%，持续 {Timer}秒。
Amulet_GiftOfMelancholy.en: Increases All Damage dealt by {DamageBuff}% when Stamina is at {StaminaThreshold}% for {Timer}s.

Amulet_GiftOfTheUnbound.zh: 取消“负担”系列戒指的负面效果，每取消一个上述效果，移动速度提高 5%。（最大 20%）
Amulet_GiftOfTheUnbound.zhTpl: 取消“负担”系列戒指的负面效果，每取消一个上述效果，移动速度提高 {MoveSpeedBuff}%。（最大 {MaxTurbo}%）
Amulet_GiftOfTheUnbound.en: Disables negative effects of Burden Rings and increases Movement Speed by {MoveSpeedBuff}% for each Burden lifted. (Max {MaxTurbo}%)

Amulet_GoldenRibbon.en: Increases Mod damage by 25%. Activating a Mod grants HASTE +7% speed to the following actions: Using consumables Evading Melee attacks Mod casts Skill casts Charging weapons (bows, fusion rifles) Firing weapons Reloading weapons Swapping weapons Environmental traversal (vaulting, climbing, wading) Movement (walking, sprinting, crouching, aiming) for 15s.

Amulet_GunfireSecurityLanyard.zh: 弹匣里的子弹随时间自动装填，对单发武器不生效。
Amulet_GunfireSecurityLanyard.zhTpl: 弹匣里的子弹随时间自动装填，对单发武器不生效。
Amulet_GunfireSecurityLanyard.en: Automatically reloads Magazine over time. Does not work for single shot weapons.

Amulet_GunslingersCharm.zh: 射速提高 15%，装弹速度提高 25%。
Amulet_GunslingersCharm.zhTpl: 射速提高 {FireSpeedMod}%，装弹速度提高 {ReloadSpeedMod}%。
Amulet_GunslingersCharm.en: Increases Fire Rate by {FireSpeedMod}% and Reload Speed by {ReloadSpeedMod}%.

Amulet_HallowedEgg.zh: 消耗枪械弹匣 30% 的弹药造成伤害后，近战伤害提高 10%，持续 7 秒。可叠加 5 层。
Amulet_HallowedEgg.zhTpl: 消耗枪械弹匣 {RangedBase}% 的弹药造成伤害后，近战伤害提高 {MeleeDamageMod}%，持续 {BuffDuration} 秒。可叠加 {MaxStacks} 层。
Amulet_HallowedEgg.en: Spending at least {RangedBase}% of a Firearm's magazine to deal damage increases Melee damage by {MeleeDamageMod}% for {BuffDuration}s. Stacks {MaxStacks}x.

Amulet_HangmansNoose.zh: 将生命值限制在 50% 并回填永久性灰色生命。所有受到的伤害将完全转化为灰色生命，灰色生命无法移除。
Amulet_HangmansNoose.zhTpl: 将生命值限制在 {GreyHealthThreshold}% 并回填永久性灰色生命。所有受到的伤害将完全转化为灰色生命，灰色生命无法移除。
Amulet_HangmansNoose.en: Restricts Health to {GreyHealthThreshold}% and backfills with permanent Grey Health. All incoming damage is fully converted into Grey Health and Grey Health cannot be removed.

Amulet_Hyperconductor.zh: 基础技能充能翻倍，但所有技能冷却时间增加 25 %。 炮台和无人机的基础涅鲁德能量储备翻倍。
Amulet_Hyperconductor.zhTpl:
基础技能充能翻倍，但所有技能冷却时间增加 {CooldownPercentage} %。

炮台和无人机的基础涅鲁德能量储备翻倍。
Amulet_Hyperconductor.en:
Doubles Base Skill Charges but increases all Skill Cooldowns by {CooldownPercentage}%.

Doubles base N'Erudian Energy Reserves for Turret and Drone.

Amulet_IndexOfTheScribe.zh: 改装和技能弱点伤害提高 35%。

MetaGem_TaintedBlade.en: Increases Melee Damage by 5% - 8% per stack of CORRODED on the target. Max 5 stacks. Level 10: Charged Melee Attacks apply

MetaGem_ThousandCuts.en: Increases this weapon's Critical Chance and Critical Damage by 0.1% - 0.5% for each shot fired. Lasts 0.125s. Max 50 stacks. Level 10: Increases this weapon's Reload Speed by 1% per stack.

MetaGem_Timewave.en: Increase this weapon's Ranged damage by 5% - 20% to enemies inflicted with SLOW status. Level 10: Mod Use applies SLOW status on all enemies within 10m for 5s. Can only happen once every 10s.

MetaGem_TopHeavy.en: Increases this weapon's Ranged Damage by up to 7.5% - 15% based on how close the magazine capacity is to full. Level 10: Increases this weapon's Weakspot Damage by up to 20% based on how close the magazine capacity is to full.

MetaGem_Transference.en: Melee Hits generate 5% of Max Ammo Capacity to the Reserves for both Firearms. Cooldown 10s- 5s. Level 10: After Ammo is Transferred, increase Reload Speed of this weapon by 50% for 5s.

MetaGem_Transpose.en: Gaining Ammo increases Ranged Damage by 5% - 15% for 15s. Level 10: New Ammo gains are added directly to into this weapon's magazine.

MetaGem_TwistingWounds.en: Increases Ranged damage of this weapon by 1% - 10% to BLEEDING targets. Level 10: This weapon's Ranged Weakspot and Ranged Critical Hits apply

MetaGem_VampireBlade.en: Increases Melee Damage by 10% - 30% while within 10m of a BLEEDING entity. Level 10: Melee Hits vs BLEEDING targets will Lifesteal 3% of base damage dealt.

MetaGem_VengefulStrike.en: Increases Melee damage by 25% - 50% when below 50% Max Health. Level 10: Increases Melee Critical Chance by 15% when below 50% Max Health.

MetaGem_VolatileStrike.en: Dealing Melee Damage creates a 3m blast which deals 50 - 150 Explosive Damage. Can only happen once every 1s. Level 10: When Volatile Strike triggers a blast, increases Movement Speed by 20% for 5s.

MetaGem_WeaponLord.en: Basic Melee Attacks increase the next Charge Attack by 7% - 15%. Max 3 stacks. Level 10: At Max Stacks, the next Charge Attack gains 100% Critical Chance.

Mod_AbrasiveRounds.en: Imbues ammunition with BLEED and increases Lifesteal by 5% for 20s. Shots also apply BLEEDING Deals BLEED damage over time. Reduces incoming healing by 50%. Reduces enemy healing from Empathy and Regenerator affixes. Can be cured by using Bandages, dealing 200 → 600 damage over 10s.

Mod_Aftermath.en: On Relic Use, Redeemer stores the wielder's equipped Relic effect with the weapon as a launchable payload. Upon firing, the payload bursts across 4m when contacting a human ally, or lays dormant up to 15s until an ally gets close. Max 1 stored Relic which cannot be modified.

Mod_AstralBurst.en: Fires a short range burst of 7 star fragments which deal 70 → 210 damage each. Fragments bounce off walls up to 3 times, dealing 10% additional damage per bounce. Weakspot hits deal reduced damage.

Mod_Banish.en: Banishes enemies or allies into another dimension for 4s. When Banish ends, enemies take 1.25x → 1.5x the damage from the Repulsor's primary fire for 8s. Powerful enemies won't be banished, but will take increased damage from any Repulsor while debuffed.

Mod_BetaRay.en: Brands a target for 30s. Branded enemies that die leave a Brand at their location. Reloading or Swapping detonates Brands dealing 275 → 825 damage. Additional Brands (3 Max) on the same target deal 50% damage. Slain enemies return 5% - 15% of Ammo and Mod Power to the weapon.

Mod_BigBang.en: Funnels all current Mod Charges into the next shot. Projectile deals 65 → 195 direct damage and 65 → 195 Explosive damage per Charge consumed in a 5m radius. Explosion applies 75 → 225 BURNING damage over 10s per Charge consumed. Additional Charges consumed increase all damage by 5%. Max 5 Charges.

Mod_BloodDraw.en: Shoots out razor-sharp Chain Shards which impale up to 5 targets within 15m, dealing 10 → 30 damage. On hit, chains are pulled towards the caster, dealing 250 → 750 damage split equally among enemies and applying 275 → 825 BLEEDING damage over 15s.

Mod_Bloodline.en: Fires a devastating blast which penetrates through all enemies in its path. Deals 150 → 450 damage with a 25% Critical damage bonus, and 3x additional stagger. Bloodline damage increases by 50% for each enemy penetrated.

Mod_Bloodshot.en: While active, grants unlimited Reserve Ammo, increases Reload Speed by 50%, and shots apply 250 → 750 BLEEDING damage over 10s. If 3 shots hit a Weakspot reloading, Merciless will automatically perform a quick Reload. Lasts 13s.

Mod_ChainOfCommand.en: Harpoon Mode: Fire Harpoon to mark target causing primary fire to become Homing Rounds dealing 15% reduced damage. Enemies hit by Homing Rounds build Influence. Recasting exits Mode. When Influence fills, Monarch automatically reloads, creates a shockwave, and gains 20% Increased Damage and Infinite Reserves. Lasts 20s.

Mod_ChaosDriver.en: Drives electrified rods which tether to other rods within 10m. Tethers last 10s and deal 20 → 60 SHOCK damage per second. Targets take 50 → 150 SHOCK damage per second, and 25% damage per extra rod. Increases 1.5x if linked to another rod. Rods in the same target will not link.

Mod_ConcussiveShot.zh: 发射一股压缩空气，穿透 8 米内的所有目标。造成 150 点伤害和 450 倍 冲击。 改装能量需求：4。
Mod_ConcussiveShot.zhTpl:
发射一股压缩空气，穿透 {Range} 米内的所有目标。造成 {Damage} 点伤害和 {Impact} 倍 冲击。

改装能量需求：{ModPowerBasis}。
Mod_ConcussiveShot.en:
Fires a focused blast of air through all targets within {Range}m, dealing {Damage} damage and {Impact}x impact.

Mod Power Requirement: {ModPowerBasis}

Mod_CubeRoom.en: Conjures a 5m anomalous Cube Room which grants allies an increase of 50% Heat Decay Rate, reduces Heat Generation per round when firing weapons that Overheat by 15% and automatically generates missing reserve ammo per second. Lasts 15s.

Mod_CubeShield.en: Generates a Cube Shield which absorbs up to 500 → 1500 damage from incoming enemy projectiles. Lasts 15s. Reactivating fires the Cube Shield which damages enemies as it travels. Damage is increased if the Cube Shield has absorbed enemy projectile damage before firing.

Mod_Deadwood.en: Disables automatic BLOWBACK, while increasing Thorn's Reload Speed by 25%, and Fire Rate by 15%. Reactivating the Mod will trigger an EMPOWERED BLOWBACK, which detonates all needles at once for 100% additional damage. Lasts 20s.

Mod_DeathBrand.en: Applies Death Brand to all non-allies within 25m, increasing incoming damage by 10%. Enemies killed while bearing the Death Brand leave behind an Echo which lasts 15s before returning to the Nightmare Realm. Echoes are drawn to any survivor who walks within 3m, increasing Weakspot Damage dealt by 10% for 10s.

Mod_Defrag.zh: 使武器感染恶意代码 30 秒，令射击施加碎片化效果，持续 5 秒。碎片化的敌人死亡后，会产生一个持续 15 秒的漏洞。 收集漏洞可使所有伤害提高 20%，持续 15 秒。 摧毁漏洞会导致不稳定状态，造成一个范围为 5 米的病毒池，每秒造成 25 点伤害，并对病毒池内的敌人施加碎片化减益效果。病毒池持续 75 秒。 改装能量需求：15。
Mod_Defrag.zhTpl:
使武器感染恶意代码 {Duration} 秒，令射击施加碎片化效果，持续 {DebuffDuration} 秒。碎片化的敌人死亡后，会产生一个持续 {GlitchDuration} 秒的漏洞。

收集漏洞可使所有伤害提高 {DamageMod}%，持续 {BuffDuration} 秒。

摧毁漏洞会导致不稳定状态，造成一个范围为 {VirusPoolRadius} 米的病毒池，每秒造成 {DOTDamage} 点伤害，并对病毒池内的敌人施加碎片化减益效果。病毒池持续 {VirusPoolDuration} 秒。

改装能量需求：{ModPowerBasis}。
Mod_Defrag.en:
Infects weapon with Malware for {Duration}s, causing shots to apply FRAGMENTED for {DebuffDuration}s. When a FRAGMENTED enemy dies, they create a Glitch that lasts {GlitchDuration}s.

Picking up a Glitch increases All damage by {DamageMod}% for {BuffDuration}s.

Destroying a Glitch causes it to destabilize, creating a {VirusPoolRadius}m Virus Pool which deals {DOTDamage} damage per second and applies the FRAGMENTED debuff to enemies inside. Virus Pools last {VirusPoolDuration}s.

Mod Power Requirement: {ModPowerBasis}

Mod_Dreadwalker.en: Enter the Nightmare Realm. Nightfall gains infinite Ammo, a 25% Fire Rate increase, 10% Lifesteal, and becomes fully automatic. The wielder becomes significantly harder to hit while moving. Disables other weapons and Skills for the duration, or until Dreadwalker is deactivated. Lasts 10s.

Mod_EnergyWall.en: Deploys an energy barrier on impact with ground. Allies can shoot through Energy Wall but enemy projectiles are absorbed (up to 500 - 1000 damage received). Max 1 Wall at a time. Lasts 30s.

Mod_Eulogy.en: Recalls bolts which deal 30 → 90 damage when pulled from a target and when striking targets on their return. Recalled bolts grant 2% of Max Health. Recalled bolts can also overfill Sorrow up to +5. Any additional bolts will be returned to reserves.

Mod_Familiar.en: Summons Fearie Familiar to aid in combat. The Familiar selects a random enemy within 10m and slashes through them for 25 → 75 damage each attack. Familiar will select a new target when the previous one dies. Lasts 20s.

Mod_Fargazer.en: Calls forth an eye of Legion to gaze at the player's AIM target. For every 0.25s Fargazer focuses on a target within 25m, a stack of MADNESS Status is applied for 5s. Each stack deals 3 → 9 Damage per second. Max 10 stacks. Lasts 30s.

Mod_Firestorm.zh: 召唤一阵旋转的风暴，将附近的目标吸入其中并施加燃烧效果，持续 5 秒。风暴中心每秒造成 75 点火焰伤害。持续 225 秒。 改装能量需求：15
Mod_Firestorm.zhTpl:
召唤一阵旋转的风暴，将附近的目标吸入其中并施加燃烧效果，持续 {FireDuration} 秒。风暴中心每秒造成 {DOTDamage} 点火焰伤害。持续 {Duration} 秒。

改装能量需求：{ModPowerBasis}
Mod_Firestorm.en:
Creates a whirling cyclone that sucks in nearby targets and applies BURNING for {FireDuration}s. The center of the cyclone deals {DOTDamage} FIRE damage per second. Lasts {Duration}s.

Mod Power Requirement: {ModPowerBasis}

Mod_FlyingBombTrap.en: Fires a projectile that deploys up to 5 traps after contacting the ground. Each trap can launch a flask of deadly liquid up to 15m when an enemy travels above and will rearm once every 1.5s. Flask detonations release a 7m shockwave which deals 50 → 150 Damage and splashes targets within 4m of the center for 100 → 300 ACID Damage, applying CORRODED for 100 → 300 damage over 10s. Lasts 20s or 10 total flask launches.

Mod_Fracture.en: Charge Attacks taint the blood of targets, causing all attacks from Godsplitter to register as Weakspot hits for 2s.

Mod_GravityCore.en: Fires a highly compressed sphere which creates a large Gravity Well on contact, pulling in enemies for 3s. When the Gravity Well expires, it deals 750 → 2250 damage within 10m. Adds 500 → 1500 damage per additional enemy and divides total damage among all enemies.

Mod_GuardiansCall.en: When Mod Power is full, Primary Fire becomes Empowered and highlights enemies it strikes. Activating the Mod calls down a Guardian Sword on enemies struck by an Empowered Energy Disc. Swords deal 150 → 450 damage and 3x stagger within 3m.

Mod_HarvesterBots.en: Releases 5 Harvester Bots for 30s that seek an enemy to siphon, granting allies within 30m a stack of DRAIN. DRAIN: Gain 1% of base damage dealt as Lifesteal per stack. Max 5 stacks.

Mod_HealingShot.en: Launches a payload that explodes on contact with allies, healing 35% of their max health. When no ally is struck, payload lays dormant until an ally gets close. Dormant payload lasts 30s, slowly losing healing potency over time.

Mod_HeatSink.en: Forces open Plasma Cutter's heat vents dispersing all heat. While active, Plasma Cutter generates 50% less heat, and ramping damage cap is increased to 3x Damage. Overheats automatically when deactivated. Lasts 20s.

Mod_Heatwave.zh: 开启一个范围 15 米的酷热光环，光环内的敌人停留 3 秒后开始燃烧，在 750 秒内持续造成 250 点火焰伤害。光环持续 5 秒。 改装能量需求：30
Mod_Heatwave.zhTpl:
开启一个范围 {Radius} 米的酷热光环，光环内的敌人停留 {ExposureThreshold} 秒后开始燃烧，在 {BurningDuration} 秒内持续造成 {Damage} 点火焰伤害。光环持续 {Duration} 秒。

改装能量需求：{ModPowerBasis}
Mod_Heatwave.en:
Activates a {Radius}m aura of sweltering heat, causing enemies inside the aura for {ExposureThreshold}s to begin BURNING for {Damage} FIRE Damage over {BurningDuration}s. Lasts {Duration}s.

Mod Power Requirement: {ModPowerBasis}

Mod_Helix.en: Shoots a helix of missiles, dealing 120 → 360 damage. On contact, divides into 6 smaller rockets which seek additional targets, dealing 30 → 90 damage on contact.

Mod_Hotshot.zh: 在弹药中灌注火焰，并提高 15% 的远程伤害，持续 20 秒。命中时造成 燃烧效果，在 600 秒内造成 200 点火焰伤害。 改装能量需求：10。
Mod_Hotshot.zhTpl:
在弹药中灌注火焰，并提高 {RangedDamageMod}% 的远程伤害，持续 {ModDuration} 秒。命中时造成 燃烧效果，在 {FireDuration} 秒内造成 {FireDamage} 点火焰伤害。

改装能量需求：{ModPowerBasis}。
Mod_Hotshot.en:
Imbues ammunition with FIRE and increases Ranged damage by {RangedDamageMod}% for {ModDuration}s. Shots also apply BURNING, dealing {FireDamage} FIRE Damage over {FireDuration} seconds.

Mod Power Requirement: {ModPowerBasis}

Mod_MegaDrive.en: Activate while a valid target is in-sights, marking it with quantum Entanglement. All Genesis projectiles seek to the Entanglement target after initial impact, dealing 35% of Primary Fire damage. While active, activating can switch Entanglement target. Lasts 15s.

Mod_Micronova.en: Fires 5 shattered star orbs. On contact, they each explode for 75 → 225 FIRE damage, and apply 200 → 600 BURNING damage over 10s to all targets within 2.75m. Striking the Micronova with Corrupted Aphelion's primary fire causes a chain reaction of larger and more powerful detonations which also apply the initial BURNING amount. Generates 1 Primary Ammo on Fire.

Mod_MoonlightBarrage.en: Empowers the Bow for 15s. Arrows apply Moonlight to enemies for 3s. Enemies struck by Crescent Moon while Moonlit release a Moon Essence which returns 1 arrow, heals 5% of Max Health, and grants 15% Fire and Reload Speed for 5s. Basic Shots automatically become Charged Shots. Perfect Shots fire two arrows.

Mod_NanoPhase.en: Detonate active Nano-bots, each dealing 100 → 300 ACID damage plus an additional 25 → 75 ACID damage per Nano-bot detonated to enemies within 2m and applies CORRODED, dealing 50 → 150 damage over 10s per Nano-bot detonated.

Mod_NanoSwarm.en: Unleash a swarm of Nanomachines that seek after enemies within 20 meters and repeatedly attack dealing 3 → 9 ACID damage per hit and applying CORRODED dealing 50 → 150 ACID damage over 5s. Lasts 10 seconds.

Mod_Ouroboros.en: Conjures 3 sword fragments that encircle the wielder for 30s. Performing a Melee Attack lets loose a Fragment which taints the blood of targets, causing all attacks from Deceit to register as Weakspot hits for a short period of time. Charge Melee Attacks fire all remaining Fragments at once but they taint blood for a shorter duration for each thrown.

Mod_Overflow.en: Imbues ammunition with SHOCK and increases Fire Rate by 15% and Reload Speed by 15% for 20 seconds. Shots also apply OVERLOADED Periodically causes bursts of SHOCK damage around the target. Multiple victims close together link up, doubling the range of the burst and increasing its damage by 10% per linked target. Can be cured by using Ethereal Orb, dealing 35 → 105 SHOCK Damage every 5s for 15s.

Mod_RecoilDampener.en: Activation stabilizes Monorail, increasing Charge Speed by 25% and reducing Recoil and Sway by 75%. Lasts 20s. Additionally, for each 5% of the Charge Meter filled upon firing, gain 1% Critical Chance and Critical Damage. Max 20%.

Mod_Sandstorm.en: Launch a sphere of loam. Impact creates a 5m swirling storm of sand which seeks to center itself on an enemy and deals 45 → 135 Elemental damage per second. When Sandstorm's focused target dies, it will seek a new enemy within 10m. Lasts 15s.

Mod_ScrapShot.en: Fires a canister that releases Caltrops over an area of 6m. Caltrops apply SLOW and BLEEDING to enemies, dealing 400 → 1200 damage over 10s. Lasts 10s.

Mod_Screamer.en: Fires a high-powered rocket that deals up to 200 → 600 damage within 2.5m.

Mod_Shatterstar.en: Imbues ammunition with FIRE. Hits apply BURNING Deals FIRE damage over time. Duration can be reduced by dodging. Can be cured by stepping into bodies of water or using Mud Rub, which deals 250 → 750 FIRE damage over 10 seconds. Lasts 20s. Hitting an enemy causes the shot to fragment, striking enemies within 7m for 30% of the initial damage dealt and also apply

Mod_ShieldingShot.en: Launches a payload that bursts on contact with allies, applying a SHIELD Acts as an additional healthbar. Shield health takes twice as much SHOCK damage. for 25% of their Max Health for 15s. Max 50% SHIELD Acts as an additional healthbar. Shield health takes twice as much SHOCK damage. When no ally is struck, payload lays dormant until an ally gets close. Dormant payload lasts 30s and slowly loses Shield potency over time.

Mod_SongOfEafir.en: Fires a shot infused with the binding power of the Song of Eafir. Staggers most ground enemies within 10m and deals 150 → 450 damage to Flying enemies within the same range. The song continues for 15s, afflicting targets within 15m with SLOW reducing their damage by 10%.

Mod_Soulbrand.en: Applies Soul Brand to all enemies within 25m which lasts 25s. Enemies killed while bearing the Soul Brand leave behind an Echo which lasts 15s before returning to the Nightmare Realm. Echoes are drawn to any survivor who walks within 3m, granting 25% of Max Health on contact.

Mod_SpaceCrabs.zh: 发射一枚异界蟹卵，碰撞后释放 5 只太空蟹。太空蟹会跟随射击者移动，跃向 4 米范围内的敌人并爆炸，每只造成 60 点伤害。 改装能量需求：180
Mod_SpaceCrabs.zhTpl:
发射一枚异界蟹卵，碰撞后释放 {NumSpawns} 只太空蟹。太空蟹会跟随射击者移动，跃向 {AttackRange} 米范围内的敌人并爆炸，每只造成 {ExplosionDamage} 点伤害。

改装能量需求：{ModPowerBasis}
Mod_SpaceCrabs.en:
Launch an alien egg that bursts on impact, releasing {NumSpawns} Space Crabs. Crabs follow the caster, leaping towards enemies within {AttackRange}m, and exploding, dealing {ExplosionDamage} Damage each.

Mod Power Requirement: {ModPowerBasis}

Mod_SporeShot.en: Fires a rotten spore that releases a specialized gas cloud over 6m. Applies SLOW to enemies while dealing 15 → 45 damage per second for 7s. Grants

Mod_Starfall.en: Fires a magical arrow which deals 30 → 90 damage and opens a 7m portal that rains down star fragments. Each fragment deals 50 → 150 damage within 2m. Last 6s.

Mod_StasisBeam.en: Fires a beam which deals 15 → 45 damage per second, and applies SLOW becomes STASIS, freezing the target in place for 10s.

Mod_Supernova.en: Fires the compressed remains of a dying star. On contact, explodes for 150 → 450 FIRE damage, and 350 → 1050 BURNING damage over 10s to all targets within 4m. Striking the Supernova with Aphelion's primary fire spawns a massive shockwave which greatly increases the area of effect, total damage, and applies the initial BURNING amount. Generates 1 Primary Ammo on Fire.

Mod_TimeLapse.en: Creates a 6m blast which freezes all standard enemies for 7s. Dealing damage to frozen enemies immediately breaks the Time Lapse effect, applying SLOW for the remaining duration.

Mod_Tremor.zh: 发射一枚弹药，砸裂地面并产生震荡波，在 225 米范围内造成 75 点伤害，持续 9 秒。震荡波造成 6 倍硬直伤害。 改装能量需求：3
Mod_Tremor.zhTpl:
发射一枚弹药，砸裂地面并产生震荡波，在 {QuakeRadius} 米范围内造成 {Damage} 点伤害，持续 {QuakeDuration} 秒。震荡波造成 {ImpactScalar} 倍硬直伤害。

改装能量需求：{ModPowerBasis}
Mod_Tremor.en:
Fires a projectile that cracks the ground and spawns shockwaves that deal {Damage} damage within {QuakeRadius}m for {QuakeDuration}s. Shockwaves inflict {ImpactScalar}x impact.

Mod Power Requirement: {ModPowerBasis}

Mod_Voidlight.en: Launches a projectile that releases Voidlight which remains dormant for 10s. While active, aborbs After expiration, explodes and fires up to 5 protectiles which home in on enemies within 15m. Projectiles deal 250 → 750 Mod Damage split among enemies hit, dealing an additional 150 → 450 per 100 Base Damage absorbed. Max 5x.

Mod_WillOfTheWisp.en: Launches a Wisp that uniquely seeks to one anchored primary fire bolt location. Bolts anchored to enemies deal 100 → 300 damage per Wisp. Bolts anchored to allies heal 10% Max Health per Wisp. Bolts are consumed when impacted by a Wisp.

Mod_Windfall.en: Fires a ring of spinning blades which penetrates targets as it travels up to 20m before returning to the weapon. While traveling, activating Windfall again causes the projectile to spin in place for up to 3s. Activating it once more will recall it. Enemies struck by the Windfall obtain Tainted Blood for 3s causing all attacks from Deceit to trigger as Weakspot hits.

Mod_Witchfire.en: Fires a highly volatile projectile that explodes to leave a line of flaming terrain. Deals 150 → 450 FIRE Damage per second, and applies BURNING Deals FIRE damage over time. Duration can be reduced by dodging. Can be cured by stepping into bodies of water or using Mud Rub, dealing 200 → 600 damage over 10s. Lasts 10s.

Perk_Amplify.en: Increases Mod Damage by 50% and grants 10% Mod Critical Chance. Increases with Archon Level.

Perk_Backbone.en: Increases the hits Medic can take before losing Grey Health by 2.

Perk_Benefactor.en: Increases Relic Use Speed by 20%. Relic Use gains -1 Stagger.

Perk_Benevolence.en: Increases Relic Efficacy by 15% and heals nearby allies for 30% of the total healing value, increasing to 60% for any ally below 35% max health.

Perk_BestFriend.en: Using a Relic fully restores the Companion's health and grants them 25% Damage and 35% Damage Resistance for 15s.

Perk_Bonded.en: When Handler is downed, Companion will attempt to revive them at 50% Max Health. Can be used to revive allies with Command. Downed ally must have a Relic charge.

Perk_CloseQuarters.en: Grants a 35% increase to All Damage to enemies within 10m. Damage bonus tapers off until 20m. Critical Chance is increased by 5%.

Perk_Communion.en: Reduces Skill Cooldowns by 1% and Heals 2% Max Health once every 3s for allies while an Invoker Skill is active.

Perk_Contingency.en: When the Warden's Health drops below 25%, gain a Shield for 25% of Max Health. Lasts 10s. Can only happen once every 30s. While active, increases Movement Speed by 15%.

Perk_DarkBlood.en: Reduces damage received from Negative s by 25%. Reduces Blight Buildup by 50%.

Perk_Deadeye.en: Gain 40% Ranged Damage and 15% Weakspot Damage and 5% Ranged Critical Chance.

Perk_DieHard.en: When receiving fatal damage, the Challenger becomes invulnerable for 3s and regenerates 100% of Max Health. While on cooldown, the Challenger gains 1 Stack of Bulwark. Can only happen once every 10 minutes. Resets at Worldstone or on death.

Perk_Dominator.en: Grants a 35% increase to Mod, Skill, and Explosive Damage, and 5% Mod, Skill, and Explosive Critical Chance.

Perk_Dynamic.en: After 10s of not being damaged, the Warden generates a Shield for 20% of their Max Health over 2s. Increases base N'Erudian Energy Reserves for Turret and Drone by 50%.

Perk_Energize.en: On Relic Use, grants a Shield for 25% of Max Health. Cannot stack with itself. Lasts 10s or until Shield is removed by damage. While active, actions which consume N'Erudian Energy have no cost.

Perk_Entranced.en: Increases Skill Damage by 30%, Elemental Damage by 15%, and Skill and Elemental Critical Chance by 5%.

Perk_Experimentalist.en: Using a Relic applies a random buff on the Alchemist and all allies within 20m for 60s. Cannot be overriden.

Perk_FaceOfDanger.en: Using a Relic within 10m of an enemy grants 2 stacks of Bulwark and 10% Increased Damage for 10s.

Perk_Galvanize.en: Grants a 25% increase to All Damage and 5% Critical Chance.

Perk_GoldToLead.en: Picking up Scrap or Metals has a 15% chance to award Ammo to the Alchemist.

Perk_HeavyMobility.en: While Carrying a Heavy Weapon, Movement Speed is increased by 35%, and both Evade Speed and Evade Distance are increased by 25%.

Perk_HighTech.en: Holding the SKILL button will Overclock a Carried or Deployed Heavy Weapon. Overclocking grants Infinite Ammo, Increased Fire Rate, and a 25% Damage increase for 25s.

Perk_Incite.en: Using a Relic grants Minions 5% Max HP per second, and increases their damage dealt by 15% and Crit Chance by 15%. Lasts 30s.

Perk_IntimidatingPresence.en: After activating a Challenger Skill, enemies within 15m deal 10% less damage for 15s, with an additional 2.5% damage reduction per enemy affected. (Max 10%).

Perk_Intuition.en: Using a Relic extends the duration of any active Hunter Skill by 10s. Effect degrades with each subsequent use. Weakspot kills against MARKED enemies increase speed of next relic use within 15s by 5%. Stacks 10x.

Perk_Invigorated.en: Grants a 25% increase to All Damage and 5% Critical Chance.

Perk_LiquidCourage.en: Grant a 25% increase to All Damage and 5% Critical Chance.

Perk_Loaded.en: When activating any Gunslinger Skill, both weapons are instantly reloaded, and gain infinite reserve ammo on all weapons for 8s.

Perk_SpiritWithin.en: Reduces Mod Power requirement per charge by 10%.

Perk_Spirited.en: Alchemist can have 3 additional Concoction buffs active.

Perk_Surplus.en: Using a Relic refills 15% of Heavy Weapon ammo. Bonus is doubled when Heavy Weapon is stowed. If the Stowed Heavy Weapon is overfilled, the Engineer will drop additional Ammo based on the surplus.

Perk_SwiftShot.en: Gain 15% Fire Rate, 25% Ranged Damage, and 5% Crit Chance for all firearms.

Perk_Teamwork.en: Handler and Companion gain 15% increased Revive Speed. While Handler or Companion are reviving, they receive 50% less damage.

Perk_Tempest.en: Automatically generate 15 Mod Power per second. Casting a Mod doubles this value for 10s.

Perk_Terrify.en: Killing an entity applies TERRIFIED to all enemies within 5m of killed entity for 20s. TERRIFIED enemies are more likely to drop additional Ammo on death. TERRIFIED: Victim deals 5% less damage.

Ring_ProvisionerRing.en: Firearms reload over time while stowed.

Ring_RallyBand.zh: 近战攻击将灰色生命值转化为生命值。每次近战攻击最多转化 10% 的最大生命值。
Ring_RallyBand.zhTpl: 近战攻击将灰色生命值转化为生命值。每次近战攻击最多转化 {HealthConversion}% 的最大生命值。
Ring_RallyBand.en: Melee Strikes convert Grey Health into Health. Each melee strike converts up to {HealthConversion}% of Max Health.

Ring_RavagersBargain.en: Increases All Damage and All Critical Chance by 5% while BLEEDING Deals BLEED damage over time. Reduces incoming healing by 50%. Reduces enemy healing from Empathy and Regenerator affixes. Can be cured by using Bandages.

Ring_ReapingStone.zh: 每当有元素状态效果从佩戴者身上移除时，佩戴者免疫所有元素状态效果，且获得相当于基础伤害 5% 的生命偷取，持续 10 秒。
Ring_ReapingStone.zhTpl: 每当有元素状态效果从佩戴者身上移除时，佩戴者免疫所有元素状态效果，且获得相当于基础伤害 {HealthStealMod}% 的生命偷取，持续 {BuffDuration} 秒。
Ring_ReapingStone.en: After an Elemental Status Effect is removed from wearer, they become immune to all Elemental Status Effects and gain {HealthStealMod}% of base damage dealt as Lifesteal for {BuffDuration}s.

Ring_RedRingOfDeath.zh: 复制目标最近获得的一个异常状态效果，但使状态效果伤害输出降低10%。
Ring_RedRingOfDeath.zhTpl: 复制目标最近获得的一个异常状态效果，但使状态效果伤害输出降低{DamageMod}%。
Ring_RedRingOfDeath.en: Duplicates the last damaging Negative Status applied to target. Reduces outgoing Status Effect Damage by {DamageMod}%.

Ring_ReroutingCable.en: Gain 5% of Max Health as a SHIELD Acts as an additional healthbar. Shield health takes twice as much SHOCK damage. for 5s after spending 20 Stamina. Accumulation resets after 5s of inaction. Max 50% SHIELD Acts as an additional healthbar. Shield health takes twice as much SHOCK damage.

Ring_ReserveBoostingGem.zh: 每秒生命回复提高 0.5。如果持续 1 秒生命低于 50%，每秒生命回复值提高至 2.5 点，持续至生命达到 50%。
Ring_ReserveBoostingGem.zhTpl: 每秒生命回复提高 {HealthRegen}。如果持续 {ThresholdDelay} 秒生命低于 {Threshold}%，每秒生命回复值提高至 {BoostedHealthRegen} 点，持续至生命达到 {Threshold}%。
Ring_ReserveBoostingGem.en: Increases Health Regeneration by {HealthRegen} per second. {ThresholdDelay}s after going below {Threshold}% Health, increases regeneration value to {BoostedHealthRegen} per second until {Threshold}% Health is reached.

Ring_RestrictionCord.zh: 治疗效果至多回复至最大生命值的 50%，但受到的所有伤害降低 15%。
Ring_RestrictionCord.zhTpl: 治疗效果至多回复至最大生命值的 {HealthThreshold}%，但受到的所有伤害降低 {DamageReduction}%。
Ring_RestrictionCord.en: Restricts the wearer from Healing above {HealthThreshold}% of their Max Health and reduces all incoming damage by {DamageReduction}%.

Ring_RingOfAshes.zh: 已收起的武器每秒回复 15 点改装能量。
Ring_RingOfAshes.zhTpl: 已收起的武器每秒回复 {ModPowerRegen} 点改装能量。
Ring_RingOfAshes.en: Stowed weapons generate {ModPowerRegen} Mod Power per second.

Ring_RingOfBones.en: On Relic Use, increase All Damage by 10% for 15s.

Ring_RingOfCrisis.zh: 生命降到 25% 以下时获得 25% 最大生命护盾，持续 10 秒

Ring_RingOfDeflection.zh: 对装备者的直接伤害有 50% 的几率完全转化为灰色生命。
Ring_RingOfDeflection.zhTpl: 对装备者的直接伤害有 {ShieldChance}% 的几率完全转化为灰色生命。
Ring_RingOfDeflection.en: Direct damage against wearer has a {ShieldChance}% chance to be converted entirely to Grey Health.

Ring_RingOfDiversion.zh: 增加闪避和滑铲时的无敌时间。
Ring_RingOfDiversion.zhTpl: 增加闪避和滑铲时的无敌时间。
Ring_RingOfDiversion.en: Increases invulnerability window while evading and sliding.

Ring_RingOfFlawedBeauty.zh: 远程弱点伤害增加 25%。未击中弱点的远程伤害减少 15%。
Ring_RingOfFlawedBeauty.zhTpl: 远程弱点伤害增加 {RangedWeakspotDamageMod}%。未击中弱点的远程伤害减少 {RangedDamageReductionMod}%。
Ring_RingOfFlawedBeauty.en: Ranged Weakspot damage is increased by {RangedWeakspotDamageMod}%. Ranged damage is reduced by {RangedDamageReductionMod}% when failing to hit a Weakspot.

Ring_RingOfGrace.zh: 承受敌人伤害后，10 秒内回复最大生命值的 15%。
Ring_RingOfGrace.zhTpl: 承受敌人伤害后，{Duration} 秒内回复最大生命值的 {HealthPercent}%。
Ring_RingOfGrace.en: Taking enemy damage causes {HealthPercent}% of Maximum Health to regenerate over {Duration}s.

Ring_RingOfOmens.zh: 闪避不消耗体力，但会将最大生命值的 15% 转化为灰色生命。
Ring_RingOfOmens.zhTpl: 闪避不消耗体力，但会将最大生命值的 {EvadeHealthCost}% 转化为灰色生命。
Ring_RingOfOmens.en: Evades cost {EvadeHealthCost}% Max Health as Grey Health instead of Stamina.

Ring_RingOfOrdnance.zh: 允许涅鲁德科技在部署或收起状态下逐渐恢复。部署时，科技将以 75% 的正常速率恢复。收起时，科技的恢复速率翻倍。
Ring_RingOfOrdnance.zhTpl: 允许涅鲁德科技在部署或收起状态下逐渐恢复。部署时，科技将以 {BaseRegeneration}% 的正常速率恢复。收起时，科技的恢复速率翻倍。
Ring_RingOfOrdnance.en: Allows N'Erudian Tech to gradually regenerate while both Deployed or Stowed. While Deployed, Tech will regenerate at {BaseRegeneration}% of the normal value. While Stowed, Tech regeneration rate is doubled.

Ring_RingOfRestocking.zh: 暴击击杀或弱点击杀后 5 秒内，装弹速度提高 20%。
Ring_RingOfRestocking.zhTpl: 暴击击杀或弱点击杀后 {ReloadInterval} 秒内，装弹速度提高 {ReloadSpeedPercent}%。
Ring_RingOfRestocking.en: Reloads within {ReloadInterval}s of a Critical Kill or Weakspot Kill are {ReloadSpeedPercent}% faster.

Ring_RingOfRetribution.zh: 受到敌人伤害后，装弹速度和所有造成的伤害提高 15%，持续 15 秒。
Ring_RingOfRetribution.zhTpl: 受到敌人伤害后，装弹速度和所有造成的伤害提高 {DamageMod}%，持续 {Duration} 秒。
Ring_RingOfRetribution.en: Incoming enemy damage increases Reload Speed and all outgoing damage by {DamageMod}%. Lasts {Duration}s.

Ring_RingOfSpirits.zh: 每个激活的消耗品都会增加 3% 的改装能量获取。最多叠加 5 层。
Ring_RingOfSpirits.zhTpl: 每个激活的消耗品都会增加 {ModGenerationBuff}% 的改装能量获取。最多叠加 {MaxStacks} 层。
Ring_RingOfSpirits.en: Increases Mod Generation by {ModGenerationBuff}% for each active consumable. Max {MaxStacks} stacks.

Ring_RingOfTheAdmiral.zh: 受到的伤害提高 200%。所有输出的伤害提高 15%。
Ring_RingOfTheAdmiral.zhTpl: 受到的伤害提高 {DamageReductionMod}%。所有输出的伤害提高 {DamageMod}%。
Ring_RingOfTheAdmiral.en: All damage received is increased by {DamageReductionMod}%. All damage dealt is increased by {DamageMod}%.

Ring_RingOfTheCastaway.zh: 基础消耗品持续时间延长 50%。
Ring_RingOfTheCastaway.zhTpl: 基础消耗品持续时间延长 {ConsumeDuration}%。

Ring_RingOfTheForestSpirit.en: Relic Healing Effectiveness is increased by 15%.

Ring_RingOfTheRobust.zh: 最大生命值提高 10，护甲提高 20。
Ring_RingOfTheRobust.zhTpl: 最大生命值提高 {HealthMaxBonus}，护甲提高 {Armor}。
Ring_RingOfTheRobust.en: Increases Max Health by {HealthMaxBonus} and Armor by {Armor}.

Ring_RingOfTheVain.zh: 闪避和战斗滑铲的无敌时间降低 35%。瞄准移动速度提高 35%。
Ring_RingOfTheVain.zhTpl: 闪避和战斗滑铲的无敌时间降低 {FrameReduction}%。瞄准移动速度提高 {AimMoveSpeed}%。
Ring_RingOfTheVain.en: Reduces Invulnerability Window on Evade and Combat Slide by {FrameReduction}%. Increases Movement Speed while Aiming by {AimMoveSpeed}%.

Ring_RockOfAnguish.zh: 每损失 25% 的生命值，移动速度提高 5%，装弹速度提高 7.5%。
Ring_RockOfAnguish.zhTpl: 每损失 {MissingHealth}% 的生命值，移动速度提高 {TotalMoveSpeedScalar}%，装弹速度提高 {ReloadSpeedMod}%。
Ring_RockOfAnguish.en: Gain {TotalMoveSpeedScalar}% Movement Speed and {ReloadSpeedMod}% Reload Speed for every {MissingHealth}% of Max Health missing.

Ring_Rotward.en: Prevents ROOT ROT Limits the Traveler's stamina from going above 70% and forces them to cough every 10 seconds. Can be cured by using Oilskin Balm. Blight.

Ring_RustedHeirloom.en: Grants 2 Stacks of BULWARK Increases damage resistance. On the Traveler: 1 Stack: +7% DR 2 Stacks: +13% DR 3 Stacks: +18% DR 4 Stacks: +22% DR 5 Stacks: +25% DR 6 Stacks: +27% DR On enemies: +10% Physical Resistance per level Maximum level: 10 below 50% Max HP.

Ring_SapphireDreamstone.zh: 暴击时，技能冷却时间减少 4%。每 2 秒可触发一次。
Ring_SapphireDreamstone.zhTpl: 暴击时，技能冷却时间减少 {CooldownReduction}%。每 {CooldownDuration} 秒可触发一次。
Ring_SapphireDreamstone.en: Critical Hits reduce Skill Cooldowns by {CooldownReduction}%. Can only happen once every {CooldownDuration}s.

Ring_SealOfTheEmpress.zh: 最大生命值提高 20 点。最大体力降低 5 点。
Ring_SealOfTheEmpress.zhTpl: 最大生命值提高 {MaxHPBonus} 点。最大体力降低 {MaxStaminaReduction} 点。
Ring_SealOfTheEmpress.en: Increases Max Health by {MaxHPBonus}. Reduces Max Stamina by {MaxStaminaReduction}.

Ring_SealedResinLoop.zh: 可以通过闪避取消正在发动的近战攻击。
Ring_SealedResinLoop.zhTpl: 可以通过闪避取消正在发动的近战攻击。
Ring_SealedResinLoop.en: Melee Attacks can be cancelled mid-action by Dodging.

Ring_SecurityHalfMeasure.en: On Relic Use, sacrifices 15% of Max Health and grants a SHIELD for 10% of the wearer's Max Health to allies within 8m. Conversion cannot kill wearer. Lasts 15s.

Ring_ShieldAlternator.zh: 激活消耗 100 点或更多改装能量的改装配件时，会生成一个相当于最大生命值 20% 的护盾，持续 15 秒。无法与自身叠加。
Ring_ShieldAlternator.zhTpl: 激活消耗 {ModThreshold} 点或更多改装能量的改装配件时，会生成一个相当于最大生命值 {ShieldAmount}% 的护盾，持续 {Duration} 秒。无法与自身叠加。
Ring_ShieldAlternator.en: Activating a Mod that costs {ModThreshold} Mod Power or greater, generates a SHIELD for {ShieldAmount}% of Max Health. Lasts {Duration}s. Cannot stack with itself.

Ring_ShinyHogLure.zh: 装弹时，根据弹匣装填比例，使两把已装备武器获取 25－-50 点改装能量。
Ring_ShinyHogLure.zhTpl: 装弹时，根据弹匣装填比例，使两把已装备武器获取 {ModFillMin}－{ModFillMax} 点改装能量。
Ring_ShinyHogLure.en: Reloading grants {ModFillMin}-{ModFillMax} Mod Power to both weapons based on percentage of Magazine reloaded.

Ring_SingedRing.en: Increases all damage dealt to BURNING enemies by 12%.

Ring_SiphonFilter.en: Increases All Damage dealt by an amount equal to an active HASTE +7% speed to the following actions: Using consumables Evading Melee attacks Mod casts Skill casts Charging weapons (bows, fusion rifles) Firing weapons Reloading weapons Swapping weapons Environmental traversal (vaulting, climbing, wading) Movement (walking, sprinting, crouching, aiming) bonus. Grants HASTE when within 15m of an entity suffering from SLOW Slows enemies by 50%. Aberrations are slowed only 20%. Bosses and World Bosses are slowed only 10%.

Ring_SlayersCrest.en: Increases Melee damage by {MeleeDamageMod}% when attacking enemies from behind.

Ring_SoulFeast.zh: 当人类、同伴或仆从被击倒或击杀时，技能冷却时间减少 8%。
Ring_SoulFeast.zhTpl: 当人类、同伴或仆从被击倒或击杀时，技能冷却时间减少 {CDR}%。
Ring_SoulFeast.en: When a Human, Companion, or Minion is downed or killed, reduce Skill Cooldowns by {CDR}%.

Ring_SoulGuard.zh: 每个在场召唤物提供 1 层 壁垒（护盾减伤）

Ring_SoulLink.zh: 召唤生物会偷取相当于其造成的基础伤害 5% 的生命值，并将其用于治疗佩戴者。
Ring_SoulLink.zhTpl: 召唤生物会偷取相当于其造成的基础伤害 {SummonHealthStealMod}% 的生命值，并将其用于治疗佩戴者。
Ring_SoulLink.en: Summons gain {SummonHealthStealMod}% of base damage dealt as Lifesteal which returns to the wearer as Health.

Ring_SoulShard.zh: 每有一个召唤物，所有造成的伤害提高 5%。最高 15%。
Ring_SoulShard.zhTpl: 每有一个召唤物，所有造成的伤害提高 {DamageMod}%。最高 {MaxDamageMod}%。
Ring_SoulShard.en: Increases All Damage dealt by {DamageMod}% for each active Summon. Max {MaxDamageMod}%.

Ring_SpiritAlternator.zh: 受到护盾时按护盾值 150% 生成改装能量

Ring_StockpileCharger.zh: 拾取弹药后，该类型弹药的伤害提高 15%，持续 20 秒。
Ring_StockpileCharger.zhTpl: 拾取弹药后，该类型弹药的伤害提高 {DamageMod}%，持续 {Duration} 秒。
Ring_StockpileCharger.en: After picking up ammo, increases the damage of that Ammo Type by {DamageMod}% for {Duration}s.

Ring_StoneOfExpanse.zh: 远程伤害提高 12%，其他所有伤害降低 5%。
Ring_StoneOfExpanse.zhTpl: 远程伤害提高 {RangedDamageMod}%，其他所有伤害降低 {DamageMod}%。
Ring_StoneOfExpanse.en: Increases Ranged damage by {RangedDamageMod}%. Reduces all other damage dealt by {DamageMod}%.

Ring_StoneOfMalevolence.zh: 元素伤害额外生成 15% 改装能量

Ring_StoneOfRevelation.zh: 改装能量生成与改装伤害 +5%（对 破绽 目标翻倍）

Ring_StrandOfSinew.zh: 使枪械充能时间减少 30%，远程蓄力伤害提高20%。
Ring_StrandOfSinew.zhTpl: 使枪械充能时间减少 {ChargeSpeedReduction}%，远程蓄力伤害提高{ChargeBasedWeaponDamage}%。
Ring_StrandOfSinew.en: Slows Firearm Charge Time by {ChargeSpeedReduction}% and increases Ranged Charge Damage by {ChargeBasedWeaponDamage}%.

Ring_StreamCoupler.zh: 使用技能后，在 10 秒内回复最大生命值的 25%。
Ring_StreamCoupler.zhTpl: 使用技能后，在 {Duration} 秒内回复最大生命值的 {HealthDelta}%。
Ring_StreamCoupler.en: Using a Skill regenerates {HealthDelta}% of Max Health over {Duration}s.

Ring_StrongArmBand.zh: 每 1% 灰血 +0.4% 全部伤害；灰血 ≥50% 时额外 +5% 暴击几率

Ring_SubterfugeLink.zh: 击杀敌人后，下次技能或改装效果的施放速度提高 35%。持续 15 秒或直至耗尽。
Ring_SubterfugeLink.zhTpl: 击杀敌人后，下次技能或改装效果的施放速度提高 {SkillCastingSpeedMod}%。持续 {Duration} 秒或直至耗尽。
Ring_SubterfugeLink.en: After killing an enemy, increases the Cast Speed of the next Mod or Skill Cast by {SkillCastingSpeedMod}%. Lasts {Duration}s or until consumed.

Ring_SuppressionWard.en: Prevents SUPPRESSION Reduces Mod Power Generation stat by 50%. Increases Skill Cooldown stat by 100%. Can be cured by using Timeworn Unguent. Blight.

Ring_SymbolOfRoyalty.en: On Perfect Dodge, grants 1 stack of BULWARK Increases damage resistance. On the Traveler: 1 Stack: +7% DR 2 Stacks: +13% DR 3 Stacks: +18% DR 4 Stacks: +22% DR 5 Stacks: +25% DR 6 Stacks: +27% DR On enemies: +10% Physical Resistance per level Maximum level: 10 for 10s. Max 3 stacks.

Ring_TargetingJewel.zh: 所有枪械的射程增加 4 米。散射减少 15%。
Ring_TargetingJewel.zhTpl: 所有枪械的射程增加 {IdealRangeIncrease} 米。散射减少 {WeaponAccuracyMod}%。
Ring_TargetingJewel.en: Increases Range on all Firearms by {IdealRangeIncrease}m. Reduces Spread by {WeaponAccuracyMod}%.

Ring_TarnishedRing.en: Increases damage of Unarmed Attacks by {UnarmedDamageMod}%.

Ring_TearOfKaeula.en: Increases Relic capacity by {BonusHearts} while equipped.

Ring_TearOfLydusa.zh: 治疗效果和生命偷取效果提高 20%。每缺少 10% 的圣物容量，治疗效果降低 1.5%。
Ring_TearOfLydusa.zhTpl: 治疗效果和生命偷取效果提高 {HealingEfficacyBuff}%。每缺少 {RelicCapacityThreshold}% 的圣物容量，治疗效果降低 {HealingEfficacyDebuff}%。
Ring_TearOfLydusa.en: Increases Healing Effectiveness and Lifesteal Efficacy by {HealingEfficacyBuff}%. Reduces Healing Effectiveness by {HealingEfficacyDebuff}% for each {RelicCapacityThreshold}% of missing Relic Capacity.

Ring_TempestConduit.zh: 受到元素伤害后，所有造成的伤害提高 15%，元素抗性提高 20，持续 15 秒。
Ring_TempestConduit.zhTpl: 受到元素伤害后，所有造成的伤害提高 {DamageMod}%，元素抗性提高 {ElementalResistance}，持续 {Duration} 秒。
Ring_TempestConduit.en: After receiving Elemental Damage, increases all damage dealt by {DamageMod}% and Resistance to the received Element by {ElementalResistance} for {Duration}s .

Ring_ThalosEyelet.en: Grants 1 stack of BULWARK Increases damage resistance. On the Traveler: 1 Stack: +7% DR 2 Stacks: +13% DR 3 Stacks: +18% DR 4 Stacks: +22% DR 5 Stacks: +25% DR 6 Stacks: +27% DR On enemies: +10% Physical Resistance per level Maximum level: 10 and 2 Stamina Regen per second for each BULWARK stack. Increases BULWARK maximum stacks to 6.

Ring_TightlyWoundCoil.en: When spending 75% or more of current magazine, gain a SHIELD Acts as an additional healthbar. Shield health takes twice as much SHOCK damage. for 15% of Max Health for 5s. Does not stack with itself.

Ring_TimekeepersJewel.zh: 提高佩戴者造成的所有状态效果的持续时间。根据状态效果，增益各有不同。
Ring_TimekeepersJewel.zhTpl: 提高佩戴者造成的所有状态效果的持续时间。根据状态效果，增益各有不同。
Ring_TimekeepersJewel.en: Increases the duration of all Status Effects applied by the wearer. Duration varies per Status.

Ring_TokenOfFavor.en: Increases All Damage by 5%. Gain 10% Critical Chance against EXPOSED targets.

Ring_ToleranceBand.zh: 枪械充能时间减少 10%，且适用远程武器的完美充能窗口延长。
Ring_ToleranceBand.zhTpl: 枪械充能时间减少 {WindupTimeThreshold}%，且适用远程武器的完美充能窗口延长。
Ring_ToleranceBand.en: Decreases Firearm Charge Time by {WindupTimeThreshold}% and increases Perfect Charge Window for applicable ranged weaponry.

Ring_TombDwellersRing.zh: 在翻越、攀爬、跳跃和涉水后，移动速度提高 10%，持续 15 秒，可叠加 3 层。跌落伤害降低 50%。
Ring_TombDwellersRing.zhTpl: 在翻越、攀爬、跳跃和涉水后，移动速度提高 {MoveSpeedMod}%，持续 {Duration} 秒，可叠加 {MaxStacks} 层。跌落伤害降低 {FallDamageReductionMod}%。
Ring_TombDwellersRing.en: Increases Movement Speed by {MoveSpeedMod}% for {Duration}s after Vaulting, Climbing, Leaping, and entering Water, stacks {MaxStacks}x. Reduces Fall Damage by {FallDamageReductionMod}%.

Ring_TransientCord.zh: 使用圣物时，暴击率提高 10%，暴击伤害提高 10%，持续 15 秒。加成效果每 1 秒降低 1.5%。
Ring_TransientCord.zhTpl: 使用圣物时，暴击率提高 {CritChance}%，暴击伤害提高 {CritDamage}%，持续 {Duration} 秒。加成效果每 {BonusReduction} 秒降低 {TimeThreshold}%。
Ring_TransientCord.en: On Relic Use, increases Critical Chance by {CritChance}% and Critical Damage by {CritDamage}% for {Duration}s. Reduce bonus by {BonusReduction}% once every {TimeThreshold}s.

Ring_VacuumSeal.zh: 废料自动拾取范围提高 150%。拾取废料、铁、或弹药时，获得等同于 15% 最大生命值的护盾，持续 15 秒。不可叠加。
Ring_VacuumSeal.zhTpl: 废料自动拾取范围提高 {AutoPickupRangeMod}%。拾取废料、铁、或弹药时，获得等同于 {ShieldAmount}% 最大生命值的护盾，持续 {ShieldDuration} 秒。不可叠加。
Ring_VacuumSeal.en: Increases Automatic Pickup Range for Scrap by {AutoPickupRangeMod}%. Picking up Scrap, Iron, or Ammo grants a SHIELD for {ShieldAmount}% of Max Health for {ShieldDuration}s. Does not stack.

Ring_VestigeOfPower.zh: 5 秒未受伤害后，远程和近战伤害提高 10%。
Ring_VestigeOfPower.zhTpl: {PostDamageDelay} 秒未受伤害后，远程和近战伤害提高 {DamageMod}%。
Ring_VestigeOfPower.en: After {PostDamageDelay}s of not being damaged, increases Ranged and Melee Damage by {DamageMod}%.

Ring_WaxSealedRing.zh: 击杀敌人后，远程和近战伤害增加 4%，持续 15 秒。可叠加 3 层。

Skill_AttackDog.en: Companion will follow the Handler and deal 20% additional damage. SINGLE PRESS: Companion engages enemies near the targeted location. DOUBLE TAP: Companion returns to the Handler and remains by their side. HOLD: Howl increases damage by 20% for all allies within 20m. Lasts 20s.

Skill_Bulletstorm.en: Unleashes the full power and speed of the Gunslinger. Increases Fire Rate 20% and Reload Speed 50% of all ranged weapons. Lasts 20s. Single Shot Weapons become fully-automatic. Kills instantly reload the current weapon. Instead of becoming fully-automatic, Bows and Crossbows gain 15% Critical Chance and 50% increased Projectile Speed.

Skill_ChaosGate.en: Conjures a 7m unstable zone which grants stacks of UNBRIDLED CHAOS. Lasts 20s. UNBRIDLED CHAOS: Allies gain 0.7% to All Damage dealt and receive 0.3% damage taken. Stacks up to 50 times. Lasts 10s. Having any stacks grants 10% Mod Generation.

Skill_Deathwish.en: Negates all healing to self. Self-inflicts 15 damage per second. Increases all Damage by 50% and grants 10% Base Damage dealt as Lifesteal. Lasts 20s.

Skill_Eruption.en: Creates 1m explosion for 50 damage on all enemies within 15m. Explosion Radius and Damage increases 100% for each unique on the target. Refreshes all

Skill_FortuneHunter.en: Increases the Explorer's Treasure Sense to reveal special items within 40m for all allies. Lasts 60s.

Skill_GoldDigger.en: Dig into the ground to spring a fountain which grants a random buff. Fountains last 45s and their buff lasts 20s. Fountains can grant either: 10% increased All Damage dealt, 15% Damage Reduction, 2 Health Regeneration per second, or HASTE +7% speed to the following actions: Using consumables Evading Melee attacks Mod casts Skill casts Charging weapons (bows, fusion rifles) Firing weapons Reloading weapons Swapping weapons Environmental traversal (vaulting, climbing, wading) Movement (walking, sprinting, crouching, aiming).

Skill_GuardDog.en: Companion will follow the Handler and generate 15% increased Threat while attacking. All damage to them is reduced by 20%. SINGLE PRESS: Companion engages enemies near the targeted location. DOUBLE TAP: Companion returns to the Handler and remains by their side. HOLD: Howl reduces damage by 15% to all allies within 20m and the Companion generates additional Threat. Lasts 20s.

Skill_HavocForm.en: Unleashes the power of the Labyrinth to empower the caster with new abilities. Lasts 30s. Duration is reduced when Havoc Form special abilities are used. FIRE: Blasts Lightning Tendrils from the Archon's hand, dealing 38 SHOCK Damage per second to targets within 15m. AIM: Raises a 3m Energy Shield which reduces incoming damage to all allies by 50%. DODGE: Performs a Blink Evade that deals 100 SHOCK damage to enemies within 5m.

Skill_HuntersFocus.en: Continuously Aiming Down Sights uninterrupted and without shooting for 0.5s causes the Hunter to enter a FOCUSED state. Wears off after 0.75s of leaving Aim. Lasts 25s. FOCUSED reduces Weapon Spread, Recoil, and Sway by 50% and grants 25% Ranged & Ranged Weakspot Damage. While FOCUSED, Aiming at enemies will automatically apply MARK. FOCUSED state can last up to 10s after the Skill duration expires. MARK: Crit Chance against MARKED enemies is increased by 10% for all allies.

Skill_HuntersMark.en: Increases the Hunter's spatial awareness by casting an Aura that automatically applies MARK to all enemies within 35m. While senses are heightened, Hunter also gains 15% increased Ranged and Melee damage. Lasts 25s. MARK: Crit Chance against MARKED enemies is increased by 10% for all allies.

Skill_HuntersShroud.en: Hunter becomes Shrouded, reducing enemy awareness and making them harder to hit while moving. Attacking or activating a Mod or Skill will instantly exit Shroud. Exiting Shroud applies MARK to all enemies within 10m and grants AMBUSH to the Hunter for 2s. AMBUSH: Increases Ranged and Melee Damage by 50% which diminishes over its duration. Ranged and Melee attacks apply MARK. Hunter will automatically Shroud again after 1.15s if no offensive actions are performed. Lasts 15s. MARK: Crit Chance against MARKED enemies is increased by 10% for all allies.

Skill_Miasma.en: Casts an AOE burst that applies BLEEDING to all enemies within 15m, and dealing a total 300In practice, damage will be higher due to the Affliction Archetype trait. base damage. Lasts 10s.

Skill_Plainswalker.en: Increases Movement Speed by 20% and reduces Stamina Cost by 80% for all allies. Lasts 30s.

Skill_Rampage.en: Enters a heightened state of battle which increases Fire Rate by 10%, Reload Speed by 25%, and Movement Speed by 15%. Lasts 10s. Kills and dealing significant damage grant 1 Stack of RAGE which increases Ranged Damage by 2.5% per Stack. Upon reaching 10 Stacks, the Challenger goes BERSERK, which reloads their current firearm and doubles Rampage effects for 15s.

Skill_RealityRune.en: Conjures a 7m protective dome which applies SLOW to any enemy or enemy projectile. Allies inside gain 25% Damage Reduction and automatically generate 50 Mod Power per second. Lasts 15s.

Skill_Reboot.en: Initiates a Data Backup of the caster's current Health, Stamina, Relic Charges, Ammo, and Negative s, which are stored for 30s. While the Backup is active, increases Movement Speed by 15% and Damage Reduction by 10%. Reactivating the Skill restores all saved values from the Backup and spawns a Decoy which lasts 3s.

Skill_Redemption.en: The Medic unleashes a 30m shockwave that revives downed allies and restores 50% Max Health over 10s. For each additional 1s holding the SKILL button, the heal gains an additional 50% (up to 200% max). Revived allies will only receive 50% of the healing amount. If revived, allies cannot be revived again by Redemption for another 180s. Resets at Worldstone or on death.

Skill_Sidewinder.en: Calls upon the power of the Desert Sidewinder snake to increase ADS Movement Speed by 50% and Draw/Swap Speed by 35%. Cycling weapons will automatically reload incoming Firearms. When a Weapon Swap provides Ammo to an incoming weapon, Duration is reduced by 6s. Lasts 60s.

Skill_VoidCloak.en: Automatically Perfect Dodge incoming direct damage for 60s. Each auto-evade reduces timer by 33% - 100% based on damage absorbed and spawns a Decoy for 3s.

Skill_WarStomp.en: Creates a high-impact tremor that deals 150 damage and additional stagger in a forward cone up to 7.5m. Deals damage in all directions at point blank range.

Skill_Wellspring.en: The Medic channels healing energy into their fist, punching a hole into the ground to create a 3m Healing Spring AOE which restores 10 Health per second and greatly increases Blight Decay Rate. Lasts 15s.

Skill_WormHole.en: Warps the caster forward through space-time. The next Melee or Ranged attack within 5s will deal 300% increased damage. Counts as a Perfect Dodge. Holding the Skill button will show the targeting device. If an enemy is directly targeted, the caster will emerge behind them.

Enemies within the mist receive 25% additional Damage and are 5% more likely to be struck with a critical hit from any source. The debuff persists for 10s after targets exit the mist.

Material_CrematedSoulAsh.en: Summons Knight Guard to aid in combat. The Guards hurl penetrating slashes at a random enemy dealing 65 → 195 damage. The Guards will melee enemies if close enough for 65 → 195 damage. Lasts 30s.

Can be cured by using Ethereal Orb, dealing 25 → 75 SHOCK damage every 5s for 15s. The orb lasts 20s. Repeatedly damaging the orb overcharges it, increasing its radius. Overcharged orb deals 50% increased pulse damage.
